LanguageData.Gun_OTs-14-1A-01_Groza-1_RWP.label: OTs-14-1A-01 Groza-1
LanguageData.Gun_OTs-14-1A-01_Groza-1_RWP.description: The OTs-14-1A-01 Groza-1 is a versatile bullpup assault rifle known for its compact design and powerful 7.62x39mm cartridge. This weapon excels in close to mid-range combat, delivering superior stopping power and high penetration. Equipped with a grenade launcher, the Groza-1 allows for tactical flexibility on the battlefield, capable of fulfilling multiple roles in a single package. Ideal for colonists who need reliability and adaptability in intense skirmishes.
